text_block_list.text:
Today, I came to observe a Senior Division 
class. They were conducting practical race 
strategy training, which piqued my 
interest.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Today, we'll be simulating the strategies 
you learned in our previous lessons.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Please work together in the pairs I 
announced earlier. Begin!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
So it seems. Partnering with me might be 
quite a heavy burden, but I look forward 
to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's try them one by one. First 
up is "Tactics when contending along the 
inner rail."

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
Wah, wait, wait! I want to double-check my 
notes from last class! Let's see~...

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Right here, the part about the final 
corner~. I'll take the lead, so pace 
yourself till the corner, and then try to 
slip through on the inside—

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text: ............Utter foolishness.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: My. Do you dislike running with me?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Do not worry. Since this is a simulation, 
I shall treat you gently.

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
—Hah. For someone of your stature, you 
spout remarkably lukewarm drivel.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...What did you say?

text_block_list.name: Classmate C
text_block_list.text:
Huh... hey, look at those two... Are they 
picking a fight...? The vibe is scary...

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
Do you truly believe a mere simulation can 
grant us what we truly seek?

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
Step onto the track, Gentildonna. I shall 
impart a proper lesson upon you.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... fine, challenge accepted. I shall 
crush you into dust.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what?! What are you two doing...?! 
Stop fighting and conduct the lesson 
properly—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Haaahhh—!! Right here... I'll pin you 
down!

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text: —Hah, insolent fool!

text_block_list.name: Classmate C
text_block_list.text:
Huh...?! Wait, aren't they having a 
dead-serious race?!

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Ah... and look at that! They're battling 
along the inner rail...!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: OOHHHH!! HAAAHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
T-They're still neck and neck?! Neither of 
them is yielding an inch...!

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
What an intense duel down the stretch...! 
So this is what it looks like in a real 
race—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Heh... ahaha! Indeed, this is how a race 
ought to be...!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
—Gah! Honestly, doing whatever you please! 
The point of this class was to simulate 
cooperatively with your partner!

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
I am saying that such an approach is far 
too soft.

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
True gains are forged only in actual 
combat. Child's play holds no value for 
We.

text_block_list.name: Teacher in Charge
text_block_list.text: —! ......I suppose you do have a point.

text_block_list.name: Teacher in Charge
text_block_list.text:
Very well. Those who wish may practice in 
real-match format. Those who prefer to 
carefully simulate and master the basics, 
please continue as you were.

text_block_list.name: Teacher in Charge
text_block_list.text:
Orfe-san, Gentil-san. Will this suffice 
for you two to properly engage in class?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Now then, Orfèvre-san, I trust you 
will continue to keep me entertained?

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text: ...My interest has already waned.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Oh my, how cold.

Though she appears to act on pure whim, 
her words carry unmistakable logic. I 
couldn't help but feel impressed by 
Orfèvre's unique way of being.

text_block_list.name: Teacher in Charge
text_block_list.text: ...That should settle the matter.

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
—Hmph. Such flexibility is worthy of 
praise.

text_block_list.name: Teacher in Charge
text_block_list.text: Eh... Ah, thank you...?

Though her demeanor was haughty, her logic 
remained sound. I found myself in awe of 
Orfèvre's distinctive presence.
